philosophy.title: Our Philosophy
paragraphs: In his formative years, his gurus Pt. Dinkar Kaikini and Ustad Alla Rakha instilled in him the importance of sharing his knowledge, wisdom and expertise. From teaching at the Ustad Alla Rakha Institute, assisting Ustadji himself, to conducting masterclasses and workshops worldwide, he has trained both hobbyists and professionals with unwavering charisma for over 40 years now.

Teaching is second nature to him, and his students perform in venues both large and small across the globe. This endeavour unites his deep-rooted values with a lifetime of dedication, aiming to inspire you to become the next torchbearer of this rich lineage and tradition.

Now, Yogesh Samsi effortlessly navigates any musical setting and this is the experience he wants to share with you here. The goal of this endeavour is to instill foundational skills and develop a holistic outlook towards the subject of Tabla.

Yogesh Ji has personally designed not only a syllabus but also instilled his unique style of teaching within his senior students. After spending his entire life perfecting his craft and learning in an un institutionalised format, it has been his dream and he has spent his entire life carving out a method that brings together the essence of the Guru shishya style of teaching and combines them with modern day goal oriented quick learning which is specially meant to cater the modern day disciple.

features.title: Redefining Online Learning, On Your Own Terms

items.title: Personalised 1:1 or Group Zoom Sessions
items.description: Everyone learns differently, some thrive solo, others flourish in a group. Whether you prefer focused one-on-one guidance or the energy of a peer learning environment, we offers both.

items.title: Personalised Time Slot
items.description: We understand that life doesn’t always follow a fixed schedule. Whether you're balancing work, school, or live in a different timezone, we let you choose a class time that truly works for you.

items.title: Downloadable PDF Class Notes
items.description: Stay fully present during class. We’ve got the note-taking covered. After every session, you’ll receive well-organised PDF notes to help you revise and reflect at your own pace.

items.title: Module-wise Reviews by Yogesh Samsi
items.description: At key points along your journey, your progress will be reviewed by none other than Yogesh Samsi. His insights will help fine-tune your understanding and bring out the subtleties in your playing.

team.title: Meet the Academy's Team
team.imageAlt: Yogesh Samsi in focus teaching a group of students silhouetted in the foreground.
paragraphs: Yogesh Samsi’s senior students who have been under his tutelage for more than 15 years one on one under guru shishya parampara. They are all highly qualified and performers in their own right. They have been specially taken through this specifically designed syllabus.

items.question: How do I enroll in the Academy?
items.answer: You can enroll in the academy by clicking the “Enroll Now” button below. We will get in touch to schedule a timeslot for your weekly session with one of our teachers.

items.question: What exactly will learn?
items.answer: You will learn be taught a comprehensive syllabus that distills this 300 year old art form into modules that methodically take you through the process of setting a solid foundation for absolute beginners all the way into intermediate and advanced concepts. You will benefit from the experience if you have been learning tabla for 0 - 3 years.

items.question: Who will be teaching me?
items.answer: ⁠Yogesh Samsi’s senior students who have been under his tutelage for more than 15 years one on one under guru shishya parampara. They are all highly qualified and performers in their own right. They have been specially taken through and trained on how to teach this syllabus most effectively.

items.question: Will Yogesh Samsi teach me personally?
items.answer: While he will not take your lessons personally, at key milestones in your journey through the syllabus, he will personally review your progress and guide you on how you can improve even further.

items.question: Do I need a tabla?
items.answer: Yes. Since classes are conducted online over Zoom, it is essential that you already have a pair of tablas.

items.question: What is the minimum age to join the Academy?
items.answer: The minimum age is 8 - 10 years. We enforce this to ensure that students physically able to play the instrument as well as pay attention in a 60 minute class.

items.question: Is there an exam?
items.answer: There will not be specific exams, written or otherwise. However, Yogesh Ji will periodically review your progress at key milestones and provide feedback on how you can improve even further.

items.question: Do I get a certificate?
items.answer: Yes, you will receive a Yogesh Samsi Online Academy certificate at the end of every module you complete.

items.question: How long is a module?
items.answer: Teachers are trained to personalise training to your needs. The time it takes to complete each module will vary based on your pace of learning and the amount of time you dedicate to practicing what is taught.

items.question: How do I make payments?
items.answer: We accept UPI or bank transfers from Indian students and international students can pay via PayPal.

items.question: How many holidays do we get?
items.answer: We follow a list of official holidays in India. If your class time slot falls on a holiday, we will schedule a make-up class at a mutually convenient time.

items.question: What happens if a teacher misses a class?
items.answer: If your teacher is not available, we will try to arrange a substitute teacher. If that is not possible, we will reschedule the class at a mutually convenient time.

items.question: What happens if my internet connection is bad?
items.answer: Unfortunately, since you have already scheduled the teacher's time, it is your responsibility if the internet connection is bad. However, if the teacher's internet connection is bad, we will reschedule the class at a mutually convenient time.
